newsitem.title: USA: Argosy completes note exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Argosy completes note exchange offer.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said it completed an exchange offer on Friday of an old debt issue, which had been a private placement, with a new issue expected to be publicly traded. Terms of the issue were the same.
Agrosy exchanged $1,000 principal amount of its old 13-1/4 percent first mortgage notes due 2004, for each $1,000 principal amount of its new outstanding 13-1/4 percent first mortgage notes due 2004.
Its exchange agent said noteholders had tendered or guaranteed delivery of $235 million principal amount of old notes, representing 100 percent of the outstanding old notes.
The notes will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange effective October 15.
Argosy develops, owns and operates riverboat casinos and related entertainment facilities.
